text:
alex_k: FYI incoming customer ask from Sara (Medicorp) — SOC2 + HIPAA + 7yr audit log retention + EU data residency + per-customer KMS + optional on-prem. Sales needs an answer on feasibility & rough ETA. Copy of questionnaire attached (link: https://files.redwood.example/medicorp_qna.pdf)

sara_sales: @alex_k thanks — they also want exportable evidence for encryption config and signed SOC2 report timeline. Sales said they'd consider Dedicated if needed.

maria_g: Paging security/product. Quick triage: Which of these are blockers for launch vs contract negotiation?

sachin_r: From security POV: EU residency + HIPAA + KMS per-customer + 7yr retention are moderately high. KMS per-customer + HSM integration = infra work (3-4 sprints). 7yr retention needs storage + egress/cost calc + retention policy + legal ok.

jen_l: Product: we need acceptance criteria. Proposal:
- "Supports per-customer CMEK using customer-provided KMS"
- "Audit logs exportable in WORM format and retained for 7 years"
- "Data at rest geo-fenced to EU region for this tenant"
- "HIPAA: BAA signed + audit controls in docs"
Also list rollout plan & canary.

compliance-bot: auto: questionnaire received — fields flagged: encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, key-management, log-retention, access-auditing.

alex_k: Sales asks for a "yes/no + ETA" to include in proposal by EOD Friday. Can we give a rough band?

sachin_r: Roughly: KMS per-customer + HSM integration = 8-12 dev-weeks. EU-residency + geo-fencing + region testing = 4-6 dev-weeks. Retention policy + cost ops = 2-3 dev-weeks. HIPAA controls + docs = 2 weeks. If we parallelize, minimum calendar ~10-12 weeks.

maria_g: Ok — let's convert into backlog PRD and label priority P1 for enterprise. Action items:
- alex_k to confirm ask details + attach questionnaire (owner: sales)
- jen_l to draft PRD with acceptance criteria + Mocks (owner: product)
- eng to scope and provide effort (owner: sachin_r)
- legal to review retention requirement for EU (owner: legal@redwood)

sara_sales: adding customer note: they require "signed BAA prior to PoC" and "monthly evidence bundle for SOC2 controls".

jen_l: I'll create PRD and a minimally scoped "SOC2+HIPAA enterprise package" option (dedicated + KMS + retention) as launch plan. Need input from eng on whether we can offer "short-term workaround" like "Redwood-managed KMS with key isolation" for faster delivery.

sachin_r: Short-term: we could offer "tenant keys via envelope encryption with our KMS" as interim, but must be documented and included in contract. That reduces time to ~4-6 weeks for POC.

alex_k: Great. Can we commit to a customer-facing ETA window (conservative)? Suggest "POC with interim keys in 6 weeks; full CMEK+HSM in Q3". Sara will push that to the buyer.

maria_g: I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow with sales, security, product, eng, legal. Invite sent.

compliance-bot: auto: meeting created — 2028-06-XX 10:00 UTC (placeholder)

sara_sales: thanks all — please paste PRD link in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
